info.name: purreddit
info.description: Transform your Reddit browsing with this Catpuccin-inspired theme that brings the beloved pastel aesthetic to your favorite platform. Built on the official Catpuccin Mocha color palette, this theme offers a refreshing alternative to Reddit's standard dark mode.
info.additionalInfo:
You need to use dark mode on Reddit for this to look the best.

It was all AI generated. I suck at coding but wanted Reddit to look better.
